acceptance: The overlay guard scans only git-tracked files matching its globs, so untracked virtualenvs or caches cannot produce findings.
The guard still flags overlays in tracked workflows, Makefile and scripts, and its coverage test still passes.
context: Merged: https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pull/3971 as 0826dcd8 (armed via make pr-arm after green CI and review verdict). Reproduction with the uv-created _project/scripts/.venv: before 1 failed/16 passed, after 18 passed including the new tracked-files regression test.
description: tests/unit/sql_compat/test_sqlglot_overlay_guard.py globs _project/scripts/**/*.py, which also walks the untracked _project/scripts/.venv. Batch tooling runs `uv run --project _project/scripts`, creating that virtualenv in every integration worktree; the public sqlglot package inside it trips the "PyPI sqlglot install" finding, so the guard fails in leader worktrees whenever an overlap rerun selects it (observed: batch sqlglot-core-delivery, 1 failed / 3644 passed). The guard is meant to check repository files only.
